# RotateEntity

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [Blitz3D](Blitz3D) · [Entities](Blitz3D-Entities)

```blitzbasic
RotateEntity entity%, pitch#, yaw#, roll#, global%=0
```

**Works in:** Blitz3D

Turns an entity to an absolute orientation. The three angles are in degrees: pitch tips it forward or back around X, yaw turns it left or right around Y and roll tilts it sideways around Z. Without `global` the angles are relative to the parent. For a turn from the current orientation use [TurnEntity](TurnEntity).

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `entity` | Int | required | Entity handle. |
| `pitch` | Float | required | Rotation around X in degrees. |
| `yaw` | Float | required | Rotation around Y in degrees. |
| `roll` | Float | required | Rotation around Z in degrees. |
| `global` | Int | `0` | 1 to use angles of the world instead of angles relative to the parent. Defaults to 0. |
